jsesh.mdcDisplayer.swing.editorApplication
Class MDCEditorApplication

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdcDisplayer.swing.editorApplication.MDCEditorApplication
public class MDCEditorApplication
extends java.lang.Object

New Application for JSesh 3.4 (and later).

Compared with the old (lack of structure), we want a light and clean structure. Actions will be created from a configuration file, and kept in a dictionary, instead of being accessible through a huge number of accessors.

Think a bit more. The application now has too parts a) create the various objects b) Swing related steps.

Author:
rosmord
